About this model
----------------

An Italian-style classic scooter with plenty of summer charm. The mint body curves from a tall leg shield with a small emblem down to a flat footboard with black grip strips, then swells into rounded side panels decorated with round badges. On top sits a caramel quilted seat with a white rear rack behind it, and a red tail light sits above a blank license plate. The handlebar holds a round yellow headlight and two small round mirrors. The scooter stands upright on its center stand. Both wheels roll on their axles, and the whole steering unit with handlebar, column, front link and fender is one object pivoting on the tilted steering axis, so it turns convincingly. Part of the Cozy Vehicles Kit, ready for real-time use. Tip: park a row of them in different pastel shades outside a café for instant Mediterranean flair.

About this model
----------------

The city ride for the last mile. This electric scooter 3d model has a flat pink battery deck with a charcoal rubber mat and a white trim line, a raked stem with a folding hinge and a T bar with soft grips. On the bar sits a small display that shows only mint and butter bars and dots, no digits. A brake lever, a thumb throttle and a round bell sit by the grips, a butter headlight shines from the stem, and the rear fender carries a coral tail light. The 10 inch air tires run on white rims with a cream hub. Wheels, the steering assembly and the side stand are separate objects with clean pivots. Part of the Cozy Vehicles Kit, it differs from the Motor Scooter with seat and from the Kick Scooter without motor. Size 1.25 x 0.52 x 1.12 m, 14,318 triangles.
